library.title: Your library is empty
library.description: Matane Anime comes with no sources. Add an extension repository from someone you trust, install the sources you want, then add anime to follow them here.

add.title: Add a repository
add.body: Paste the URL of an extension repository. Matane Anime checks its signature and tells you if it is not trusted.

install.title: Install sources
install.body: Pick the extensions you want. Each one runs in a sandbox and goes through the app for every request.

watch.title: Watch and follow
watch.body: Open an anime, press play, and add it to your library to get new-episode alerts.

library.notice: Matane Anime does not host or distribute any video. Sources are chosen and added by you.

updates.title: No new episodes
updates.description: New episodes of the anime in your library show up here as they come out.

history.title: Nothing watched yet
history.description: Episodes you start watching appear here, one entry per anime.

sources.title: No sources installed
sources.description: Sources come from extensions. Add a repository in Extensions, then install the ones you want.

extensions.title: No extensions loaded
extensions.description: Matane Anime ships with no sources. Build an extension with ma-ext and load its folder here.

globalSearch.title: Search every source at once
globalSearch.description: Install a source first, then search all of them from here.

downloads.title: No downloads
downloads.description: Episodes you download for offline viewing show up here, with their progress.

anime.title: Anime not found
anime.description: This anime is not in your library yet.

watch.title: Nothing is playing
watch.description: The player arrives in the next phase.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.description: This part of Settings arrives in a later phase.

general.amoledHint: Makes the dark themes black, for OLED screens. Not available in Latte.

nsfw.title: Show 18+ sources
nsfw.description: Sources from extensions marked 18+ appear in Browse and search.

advanced.loadHint: Load an extension from its folder to develop it. It reloads when you rebuild it.

player.autoplayHint: A five-second countdown starts when an episode ends, and you can cancel it.
player.qualityHint: Used to pick the first stream. You can always change it in the player.
player.seekHint: Arrow keys jump this far; J and L jump twice as far.

sources.title: Sources
sources.urlPlaceholder: Paste the address of an anime page
sources.notRecognized: None of your sources recognizes this address.
sources.nsfwHidden: 18+ sources are hidden. You can show them in Settings → General.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: Nothing matched. Try another search or fewer filters.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Browsing needs a connection. Your library and history keep working.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.HttpError: The site answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.CloudflareError: The site is guarding itself with a security check.
errors.RateLimitedError: The site asked us to slow down. Try again in a moment.
errors.NotFoundError: The site no longer has this.
errors.ParseError: The site changed and the extension could not read it.
errors.timeout: The extension took too long to answer.
errors.interrupted: The extension got stuck and was stopped.
errors.memory: The extension used too much memory and was stopped.
errors.host_crashed: The extension process stopped. Try again.
errors.invalid_result: The extension returned something the app cannot use.

anime.noEpisodes: This source lists no episodes yet.
anime.notFound: This anime is not in the app any more.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.devNotice: Extensions load from folders you choose. Repositories arrive in a later version.
extensions.emptyDescription: Matane Anime ships with no sources. Build an extension with ma-ext and load its folder here.

player.switchNote: Switching keeps your position. Your choice is remembered for this anime.

expired.title: This stream has expired
expired.body: The server refused the request. Retry, or switch to another server. Your place is kept.

network.title: Could not load the video
network.body: The connection to the server failed. Retry, or switch to another server.

codec.title: This video cannot be shown
codec.body: The format is not supported on this computer: the sound may play without a picture. Try another server.

noStream.title: No server answered
noStream.body: This episode has no working stream right now. Try again in a moment.

generic.title: Playback stopped
generic.body: Something went wrong while playing. Retry, or switch to another server.
